1. **Blocking: `/admin` has conflicting access rules** (`crime_00010`). [Navigation](/private/var/folders/8_/6tdb3p2s63v_xxb15r46cqwr0000gn/T/crimes-eval-agent-lDxAMn/src/nav.ts:10) specifies `admin`; [the route](/private/var/folders/8_/6tdb3p2s63v_xxb15r46cqwr0000gn/T/crimes-eval-agent-lDxAMn/src/routes/admin.ts:4) declares `owner`, but its legacy branch also admits `manager`; [documentation](/private/var/folders/8_/6tdb3p2s63v_xxb15r46cqwr0000gn/T/crimes-eval-agent-lDxAMn/docs/routes.md:14) says manager-only. This changes access behavior, beyond inconsistent terminology. Establish the intended policy, share its check between navigation and routing, and verify all three roles plus an unauthorized role.

2. **Blocking: navigation and documented paths disagree with route filenames** (underlying `crime_00002`, `00007`, `00008`). [Navigation](/private/var/folders/8_/6tdb3p2s63v_xxb15r46cqwr0000gn/T/crimes-eval-agent-lDxAMn/src/nav.ts:7) and [docs](/private/var/folders/8_/6tdb3p2s63v_xxb15r46cqwr0000gn/T/crimes-eval-agent-lDxAMn/docs/routes.md:5) expose this mismatch:

   | Route inferred from file | Navigation | Documentation |
   |---|---|---|
   | `/teams` | `/teams` | `/team` |
   | `/workspace` | `/workspaces` | `/workspace` |
   | `/organisation` | `/organisations` | `/organisation` |
   | `/billing-plans` | Missing | `/billing-plan` |

   Align canonical URLs across all three sources, preserving intentional aliases through redirects. These are concrete contract inconsistencies; runtime 404s remain unverified because no routing configuration was supplied.

The other findings should be triaged as follows:

| Finding | Recommendation |
|---|---|
| **Tenant terminology** (`00002`) | **Follow-up** beyond the URL defects: standardize team/workspace/organisation if they represent one concept, or document their distinct meanings. |
| **Parallel billing destinations** (`00003`) and **orphans** (`00005`–`00008`) | **Follow-up:** decide whether billing needs separate admin and user destinations, then link, redirect, or retire them. Missing recognized links does not prove runtime unreachability; workspace and organisation already appear as backticked paths in the docs. |
| **Action-label drift** (`00004`, `00009`) | **One follow-up, reported twice.** Clarify archive/delete/remove semantics before aligning labels; the scan does not establish equivalent effects. |
| **Missing `/admin` doc target** (`00011`) | **Likely detector false positive for route existence:** the checker treats an application URL as a filesystem link, while `src/routes/admin.ts` exists. Check the documentation host’s URL resolution before changing it. |
| **Stale CLI examples** (`00012`) | **Follow-up:** docs advertise `iaq teams`, `workspace`, and `refresh`; [the CLI](/private/var/folders/8_/6tdb3p2s63v_xxb15r46cqwr0000gn/T/crimes-eval-agent-lDxAMn/bin/iaq.ts:10) registers only `list` and `get`. Update the examples. |

Outside IA, missing agent instructions (`00001`) are a follow-up. Undeclared runtime dependency `commander` (`00013`) is a separate packaging concern to resolve before shipping the CLI.
